page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz with an x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core execution is a bottleneck, with stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25% category, and single-threaded gzip compression registering in the bottom 10%. However, the 16 dedicated physical cores compensate during parallel workloads. Multi-core performance, including stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU tests, consistently ranks in the middle 50% average tier. Memory bandwidth for both read and write operations also performs at an average level.

Given the 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and average multi-core capabilities, this instance is suited for general-purpose workloads that benefit from parallel processing but do not require high single-thread performance. Appropriate workloads include static web serving, Redis database operations, and multi-threaded decompression tasks, which all achieved average benchmark ratings. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation provides predictable multi-threaded performance, though the lack of bundled local storage means storage costs must be factored in separately.
